purpose: First conversion batch for #4647: move 13 conjunctive PASS conditions in the session, authorization and token chapters from PRESENT_AT_PATH (which matches with .some()) to PRESENT_ALL_AT_PATH, and add a register-wide test that every conjunctive condition both holds today and stops holding when any single fact it names is removed.
requiredInvariants: Only the check type changes on the converted conditions - no pattern, path, verdict, evidence or note is edited, so no requirement's assessment moves.

V7.2.1 and V11.3.4 are deliberately NOT converted: each of their named paths carries only its own spelling of the control, so .some() per path is the correct semantics there and converting would reject two sound PASS decisions.
V16.2.5 is deliberately NOT converted: two of its three patterns match nothing anywhere in the repository, so it needs its evidence repaired rather than its check type changed.
Every converted condition is proven revocable by removing each named fact in turn, not by reading the condition - both defects behind #4647 were invisible to reading.
No application code changes; no production, REG.RU, DNS or database mutation.
acceptance: 13 conditions across V7.2.2, V7.2.3, V7.2.4, V7.4.1, V7.4.2, V7.4.5, V7.6.2, V9.1.1, V9.2.1 and V10.2.1 use PRESENT_ALL_AT_PATH.
Rebuilding the matrix keeps decisionsApplied at 332 and decisionsRejected at 0, with unchanged blockers.
The new register-wide test runs 29 removals across those conditions and every one revokes.
